title: Sereja and Two Sequences
statementMd:
Sereja has two sequences $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ and $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*}$, consisting of integers. One day Sereja got bored and he decided two play with them. The rules of the game was very simple. Sereja makes several moves, in one move he can perform one of the following actions:

1. Choose several (at least one) first elements of sequence $*a*$ (non-empty prefix of $*a*$), choose several (at least one) first elements of sequence $*b*$ (non-empty prefix of $*b*$); the element of sequence $*a*$ with the maximum index among the chosen ones must be equal to the element of sequence $*b*$ with the maximum index among the chosen ones; remove the chosen elements from the sequences.
2. Remove all elements of both sequences.

The first action is worth $*e*$ energy units and adds one dollar to Sereja's electronic account. The second action is worth the number of energy units equal to the number of elements Sereja removed from the sequences before performing this action. After Sereja performed the second action, he gets all the money that he earned on his electronic account during the game.

Initially Sereja has $*s*$ energy units and no money on his account. What maximum number of money can Sereja get? Note, the amount of Seraja's energy mustn't be negative at any time moment.

## Input

The first line contains integers $*n*$, $*m*$, $*s*$, $*e*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}; 1 ≤ *s* ≤ 3·10^{5}; 10^{3} ≤ *e* ≤ 10^{4})$. The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}$, $*a*_{2}$, $...$, $*a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5})$. The third line contains $*m*$ integers $*b*_{1}$, $*b*_{2}$, $...$, $*b*_{*m*}$ $(1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5})$.

## Output

Print a single integer — maximum number of money in dollars that Sereja can get.
statementZhMd:
Sereja 有两个由整数构成的序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ 和 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*}$。一天，Sereja 感到无聊，于是决定用它们玩游戏。游戏规则非常简单。Sereja 可以进行若干次操作，每次操作可以执行以下动作之一：

1. 选择序列 $*a*$ 的若干个（至少一个）首元素（即 $*a*$ 的一个非空前缀），再选择序列 $*b*$ 的若干个（至少一个）首元素（即 $*b*$ 的一个非空前缀）；所选序列 $*a*$ 中下标最大的元素必须等于所选序列 $*b*$ 中下标最大的元素，然后从两个序列中删除所选元素。
2. 删除两个序列中的所有元素。

第一次操作消耗 $*e*$ 点能量，并向 Sereja 的电子账户中增加 1 美元。第二次操作消耗的能量等于执行该操作前 Sereja 从序列中删除的元素总数。执行第二次操作后，Sereja 将获得游戏过程中电子账户中的全部金钱。

初始时，Sereja 拥有 $*s*$ 点能量，账户中没有金钱。Sereja 最多能获得多少美元？注意，在任何时刻 Sereja 的能量都不能为负数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含整数 $*n*$、$*m*$、$*s*$、$*e*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}; 1 ≤ *s* ≤ 3·10^{5}; 10^{3} ≤ *e* ≤ 10^{4}$）。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}$、$*a*_{2}$、$...$、$*a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$）。第三行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*b*_{1}$、$*b*_{2}$、$...$、$*b*_{*m*}$（$1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——Sereja 最多能获得的美元数。
